GREEN: added #ROOT_ENVELOPE_KEYS, allow-list root leaves now kept only for envelope keys, #childRegion drops foreign root keys to data. Verified: 40/40 redaction tests, 474 unit + 458 workers tests, typecheck, lint all green. JSDoc (redactAllow, #childRegion, RedactRegion) + CHANGELOG (Unreleased/Fixed) updated. Not committed yet.

Fixed test-first. RED: 6 new cycle tests failed with 'Circular cause chain detected' (2-cycle root, self-cycle, filter exactly-once x2, every/some on cycle, isChainRetryable false-case). GREEN: generator rewrite in traverseCauseChain: seen-check before yield, return instead of throw; JSDoc @throws removed, maxDepth documented as hops (n+1 nodes, pinned by existing tests). CHANGELOG Unreleased/Fixed entry with migration note. Verified: 480 unit + 464 workers tests, typecheck, lint green. Committed as 193304d.

Resolved by the base-error-ts-y5n generator rewrite (commit 193304d): seen-check now runs before yield, so each node is yielded exactly once (regression tests: filterCauseChain on self-cycle and 2-cycle assert exact arrays); maxDepth contract (hops, up to n+1 nodes) kept, pinned by existing 'respects maxDepth' tests and documented in the JSDoc of all five helpers.

Fixed test-first. RED: 3 of 6 new toString tests failed (message leak direct, in cause chain, function mask). GREEN: #messageMask set by redact() when keys include 'message' (cleared by redactAllow/redactWith, last-wins), toString renders via #renderMessage with fail-closed String() + try/catch. Docs: JSDoc scope warnings on all three redaction APIs, observability guide note, pitfalls #5. Verified: 486 unit + 470 workers, typecheck, lint green. Commit follows in git log.

Fixed test-first. RED: prepareStackTrace-counting test proved construction symbolized (1 call), memoization-descriptor test failed. GREEN: #installLazyStack captures onto a plain holder via captureStackTrace, this.stack becomes memoizing accessor (get: filter+install data prop; set: install verbatim); non-V8 fallback captures raw eagerly, filters lazily; setPrototypeOf guarded by prototype check. Benchmark (50k iterations, 50-frame stacks): construct-only 2662ms -> 1681ms (-37%), construct+read 2639 -> 2775ms (+5%, expected trade-off). 492 unit + 476 workers (workerd honors prepareStackTrace), typecheck, lint green. CHANGELOG entry. Commit in git log.

Fixed test-first with a scope adjustment: variant A (JSON-safe clone of details in project) was rejected during implementation because the json-safety test file documents the two-stage contract explicitly (in-process view may hold rich values like Date; toProblem is the wire boundary) and existing tests assert Date-bearing details surviving to toProblem. Implemented: fields normalized to frozen {field,code} copies in safeFields (extras stripped, references decoupled; RED: 2 failing tests), details stays by-reference pinned by a characterization test + strengthened projectDetails/projectFields JSDoc (variant B). One toProblem test adapted to hand-built view since project can no longer emit non-JSON-safe fields. 495 unit + 479 workers, typecheck, lint green. Commit in git log.

Fixed test-first. RED: 2 new tests failed (segment extras crossing, shared array/segment references mutable after projection). GREEN: #defaultProjection maps path to a fresh array with object segments narrowed to {key}; primitive segments pass through; pointer derivation unchanged. mapIssue JSDoc documents that custom mappers replace the whitelist. 497 unit + 481 workers, typecheck, lint green. Commit in git log.

Fixed test-first. RED: test mocking only Date.now proved timestampIso came from a second clock read. GREEN: timestampIso = new Date(this.timestamp).toISOString() (field init order guarantees timestamp is set). Full suite, typecheck, lint green. Commit in git log.

Fixed test-first. RED: mutation test proved payload/error shared the details object. GREEN: shallow copy in #fromJSON; guarantee depth (top level decoupled, nested shared) documented in fromJSON JSDoc and CHANGELOG. Full suite, typecheck, lint green. Commit in git log.

Fixed test-first. RED: empty/whitespace keys and parent-before-subclass ordering were accepted. GREEN: key.trim()==='' rejected (numeric check simplified accordingly), O(n^2) prototype-instanceof shadowing check with actionable message; subclass-before-base dispatch pinned by guard test. Note: type level already rejected the whitespace key ('  ' matches ${number}? no — TS rejected it via ValidClassDefinition), directives adjusted. 502 unit tests, typecheck, lint green. Commit in git log.

Fixed test-first. RED: 4 tests (DAG helper, 18 levels ≈ 500k visits) proved all three walkers expand shared references to completion (~160ms each; larger inputs unbounded). GREEN: {nodes} counter threaded through cloneJsonSafe (throws not-JSON-safe), cloneJsonValue (throws metadata error at definition time), #redactWalk (returns '[Max redaction size exceeded]' marker, fail-safe). Budget 100_000 per walk, private constants with DoS rationale. Sane-payload guard test (10k-element array) stays green. 507 unit + 491 workers, typecheck, lint green. Commit in git log.

Resolved with the perf hypothesis REFUTED by measurement: a hand-rolled single-pass JS walker (full JSON semantics incl. toJSON/omit/null rules) measured ~65% SLOWER than the native JSON.parse(JSON.stringify()) pair (119ms vs 72ms per 20k toJSON calls), so the round-trip stays as the fastest implementation. Shipped instead: 6-test characterization suite pinning cause-payload JSON semantics, plus a 100k-node counting-replacer budget closing the shared-reference blowup on this unconditionally-running path (replacer costs ~50% on plain-object causes, accepted as bounded-work tradeoff; absolute cost ~6.5us/toJSON). matchThrown O(n^2) left untouched per the bead's own design note (do not optimize proactively, case counts tiny). 513 unit + 497 workers, typecheck, lint green. Commit 143be71.
